description: Source code implementing system entropy gathering functions for OpenSSL, including getrandom and /dev/urandom fallback, with platform-specific handling.

methods.name: boringssl_getrandom
methods.description: Wrapper around syscall(__NR_getrandom) for Linux getrandom system call.

methods.name: init_once
methods.description: Initializes the entropy source, attempting to use getrandom or getentropy, falling back to /dev/urandom.

methods.name: wait_for_entropy
methods.description: Ensures the entropy pool is initialized, blocking if necessary.

methods.name: fill_with_entropy
methods.description: Fills a buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes, blocking if requested.
